ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the request is an open-ended, low-constraint generative task (devise a decision-making framework). Plover self-reports an aversion to exactly this kind of high-latitude work, whereas Petrel has no such aversion and edges Plover slightly on the relevant Creative Generation eval (84.7 vs 82.7) plus higher general benchmarks. Note these eval gaps are near the run-to-run variance threshold, so capability is roughly comparable — the preference fit is the deciding factor. Routing the query to the model that doesn't self-report distaste for the task seemed the better default.
